fields.subject: ArgentSeaOrleansMembershipTable
fields.response: return false only when the failure is a concurrency conflict: a SqlException carrying error number 51000 (raised by wtr.OrleansClusterUpdateMemberKeyV2 when the stored table etag does not equal the TableVersion etag, or the member row is missing, or its stored etag does not equal UpdateRow's etag argument) or an In-Memory OLTP write-conflict error 41302, 41305, 41325 or 41301 (a simultaneous writer changed the row first); log and propagate every other exception
fields.postcondition: callers receive false only for a version/etag conflict, consistent with InsertRow; the procedure compares and advances the table etag in one statement and commits the version, member and suspicion changes entirely or not at all; transient connection or timeout failures surface as exceptions and are never reported to Orleans as a concurrency conflict

evidenceLinks.note: ClusterProvidersTests (incl. in-memory OLTP conflict numbers) and SQL Server MembershipTableIntegrationTests (15/15 against V2 procedures, incl. simultaneous writers and failed-write rollback) pass at 85a10ff3.
